entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm home, Father.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Drive them away.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: ...That's right. Make it a priority.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: I finally get a foothold into politics[n]and this happens.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Phantom Thieves? Hmph!

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Did the media ask you anything?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: No, not at all...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Um, what's this about Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: It seems I'm ranked first on the forum of[n]these so-called Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Is it because of the news coverage?

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: It's jealousy of the successful.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Nothing but the barks of the masses who[n]lack the resolve to sacrifice what's needed[n]for their well-being.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Both the young and the old are overjoyed[n]with some foolish idols. This country has[n]no future.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What if they do exist? What if these[n]Phantom Thieves really can steal hearts?

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Are you still having doubts about me?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: No...

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: More importantly, I hope things are[n]going well with that young man.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Yes, Father.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Very well then.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: He may not seem like it, but he's still[n]the son of an influential politician.[n]Be cordial with him.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: He'll eventually become a necessary[n]connection for this company—or rather,[n]for me.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...I understand.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I will do the best I can.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: Good.

entries.speaker: Okumura
entries.en: That's how a daughter of Okumura[n]should be.
